theory_proposal.proposed_mechanism_or_principle: Intervention-Stable Causal Quotient (ISCQ): Q0 is the minimal matched-privilege predictive quotient; QI is the minimal quotient that additionally preserves a predeclared local-intervention response vector. The causal refinement gap QI-vs-Q0 is the programme-level target. Zero gap means no tested causal information beyond ordinary predictive state; nonzero gap is only a mechanism candidate after ordinary local dynamics/FSA/reservoir/eligibility/STP and abstraction-equivalence reductions fail.
theory_proposal.why_existing_models_may_be_insufficient: Only if histories matched in ordinary predictive state respond differently to the same frozen local intervention. This is not assumed; a compact FSA, reservoir, predictive-state, eligibility, STP, or causal-bisimulation model may absorb the full effect and thereby reduce the Theory.
predictions: Most already reduced terminal surfaces have near-zero causal refinement gap.
A genuine responsibility phenomenon yields predictive-equivalent histories with divergent response to the same frozen local intervention.
Any real residual survives admissible realization reparameterization and attaches to a causal equivalence class rather than an arbitrary coordinate name.
If adaptation/refractory/eligibility/STP variables predict the intervention response, they are ordinary quotient state rather than new mechanism evidence.
Unique topology is not implied unless a prospective separating intervention design identifies it.
falsifiers: A compact privilege-matched ordinary model predicts all declared intervention-conditioned outcomes.
The refinement gap vanishes after matching local state/timing/resource variables.
The gap exists only under outcome-selected interventions.
The split depends on arbitrary native coordinate labels and disappears under admissible reparameterization.
The comparator uses privileged target/global/evaluator information.
Only microscopic differences remain with no downstream observable effect.
ordinary_reduction_ladder: native local residual only after the above fail
theory_proposal.minimal_discriminator: Prospectively select history pairs assigned to the same matched-privilege unperturbed predictive class, apply the same frozen local intervention family, and require a reproducible downstream response difference that forces QI to split Q0 and is not explained by ordinary local/timing/FSA/reservoir/eligibility/STP state.
theory_proposal.suggested_forge_probe: Only after later Evidence Analyst gating, on already exposed stable synthetic surfaces, construct a tiny Q0 predictive partition and test whether predeclared local interventions force any QI split. Report class structure and ordinary state variables explaining each split. Do not touch protected H7 or terminal same-object surfaces.
theory_proposal.relation_to_existing_candidates: Programme-level only. H7 is adjacent but its unknown outcome is not used. Candidates #34 and #35 remain terminal and are not rescued. Canonical terminal evidence supplies reduction constraints, not positive Theory evidence.
